tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search over Inside the Loop posts about AI agents, coding agents, MCP and the agent-readable web. Returns titles, slugs, URLs and snippets.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Return one post as Markdown, with its URL, publish date and sources. Use the slug from search_posts or list_recent_posts.

tools.name: list_recent_posts
tools.description: List the newest posts with title, slug, URL, date and one-line summary.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the CLIs with living tool pages (ASC CLI, Codex CLI, Wrangler, ...): latest version, UTC release date, last verified date and page URLs.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Return one tool page as Markdown: latest version and release date, upgrade command, last five releases, commands and flags added or removed (our sandbox --help diff), breaking changes, reproduced errors with fixes, monthly history and sources. Accepts the tool id or a common name (asc, app-store-con

tools.description: Find the fix page for a CLI error message. Paste the exact error line, a fragment of it, or the whole terminal output (for example "unexpected argument '--full-auto' found"). tools.name: get_fix

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_recent_posts, list_tools, search_fixes · Public sink: get_post · Destructive: get_fix.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_recent_posts, list_tools, search_fixes · Public sink: get_post · Destructive: get_fix

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
